The program tries to tell you honestly when it couldn't find or verify something instead of making it up. Issues are welcome.

中文: Lulu 只做九件事（0.6 加了翻译），每件事是一条固定程序，模型只在其中一两个槽位出场（`lulu/skills.py`）：转换格式、生成文档、总结/提取、记录（笔记或长期记忆）、提醒/闹钟（`lulu/timeparse.py` 解析中文时间与重复）、查询（本地文件 + 联网核对）、记忆问答（我记得什么 / 忘掉某条）、闲聊。路由规则优先（`route_rules()`），决定性句式命中就不调分类模型；问句一律算查询（有搜索钥匙就联网，没资料就按模型知识回答并标注）；生成文档必须先有材料或要点，否则零模型调用直接问；缺槽位（哪个文件、什么格式、什么时间、忘掉哪条）时程序发定向问题，带选项，用户答复后同一任务从原地继续。两件事写在一句里（既要记住又要生成文件）走通用循环兜底。
English: Lulu handles nine types of task (translation was added in 0.6). Each follows a fixed program flow, with the model used at only one or two points (`lulu/skills.py`): format conversion, document creation, summarization/extraction, notes or long-term memory, reminders/alarms (`lulu/timeparse.py` parses Chinese times and repeats), search (local files + verified web information), memory Q&A (what I remember / forget an item), and chat. Routing rules come first (`route_rules()`); decisive phrasing skips model classification. Questions route to search (online when a search key is available; otherwise, without sources, an answer from model knowledge is labeled as such). New documents need sources or key points first; if missing, the program asks without calling the model. Missing details (which file, format, time, or memory to forget) trigger targeted questions with options. The same task resumes after the reply. Requests combining two actions, such as remembering something and creating a file, use the general loop as a fallback.

中文: 模型只剩五种提示词：起草、摘要、字段提取、联网事实核对、记忆命名，每种都有 schema 和程序验收（数字必须有来源、原文标签事实必须保留、引用必须逐字命中）。对话结束后程序按原话抽取"值得记住的事"作为候选，用户在记忆页采纳才会存。
English: The model uses five kinds of prompt: drafting, summarizing, field extraction, web fact checking, and memory naming. Each has a schema and program checks: numbers need sources, labeled source facts must be kept, and quotes must match exactly. After a chat, the program extracts potentially useful memories from the user's own words. They are saved only after the user accepts them on the Memory page.

中文: 每个任务按阶段推进并逐步落库：`classifying`（一次 schema 约束的意图分类，程序用规则校正）→ `planning`（证据需求与完成条件）→ `gathering`（固定流程、读取用户提到的文件、实时行情适配器）→ `executing`（模型工具循环，每步写入 `task_steps`）→ 验收 → 完成。任一阶段缺少必需信息时进入持久的 `awaiting_input`，用户答复后同一个任务从中断的阶段继续；已生成且哈希未变的产物不会重做。
English: Each task advances through stages, saving progress as it goes: `classifying` (one schema-constrained intent classification, corrected by rules) → `planning` (evidence requirements and completion criteria) → `gathering` (fixed flow, reading user-named files, real-time market adapters) → `executing` (model/tool loop, with every step written to `task_steps`) → verification → completion. Missing essential information at any stage puts the task into persistent `awaiting_input`. The same task resumes from the interrupted stage after the user's reply. Existing outputs with unchanged hashes aren't recreated.

中文: 撰写器返回结构化 JSON（`status / body_markdown / assumptions / questions`），由程序做三层验收：结构、与证据的一致性（统计数值回填、来源事实保留、实时任务必须有适配器或用户证据）、内容（伪正文正则命中时再由模型二选一判别，问卷/确认函/清单/模板类不拦）。撰写器自行确定的口径会写进文档末尾的"口径说明"。
English: The writer returns structured JSON (`status / body_markdown / assumptions / questions`). The program checks three layers: structure; consistency with evidence (statistics included, source facts preserved, and real-time tasks backed by adapter or user evidence); and content (if patterns detect an explanation posing as body text, the model makes a binary classification; questionnaires, confirmation letters, checklists, and templates are exempt). Scope and definitions chosen by the writer are added at the end under “Scope and definitions”.

中文: 联网走通用检索（`lulu/research.py` + `lulu/websearch.py`）：程序生成 1–3 条查询 → 依次尝试 Bing、DuckDuckGo、百度（无需密钥，可在 config 里调整顺序）→ 并发抓取前几页并提取正文与页面摘要 → 模型只能以"网页原文逐字引用"的形式列出事实，程序逐条核对引用确实出现在该网页里，核对不过的一律丢弃 → 撰写器只拿核对过的事实写作 → 正文里每个数字都必须来自核对过的原文或用户原话，否则打回重写；口头回答同理，含无来源数字的回答会被程序按核对过的事实重写并附来源。搜索失败按网络不通、引擎拒绝访问（需人工验证）、无结果、网页抓取失败、找不到可核对内容分类，用户可选择换个说法、上传资料或改为模板。
English: Web research uses `lulu/research.py` + `lulu/websearch.py`: generate 1–3 queries → try Bing, DuckDuckGo, and Baidu in order (no key needed; order is configurable) → fetch the first few pages concurrently and extract body text and summaries → have the model list facts only with exact page quotations, which the program checks and discards if unmatched → write using verified facts only → check that every number comes from a verified passage or the user's own words, otherwise request a rewrite. The same applies to chat replies: unsupported numbers trigger a rewrite using verified facts with sources. Failures are classified as no network, access denied/human verification needed, no results, page-fetch failure, or no verifiable content. Users can try another search, upload sources, or switch to a template.

中文: 超时与上下文预算由 `lulu/budget.py` 按实测速度推导（`POST /api/budget/measure`），内存低于 12GB 的机器自动落到 A 档（4096 上下文、更短提示词）。
English: Timeouts and context budgets are calculated from measured speed by `lulu/budget.py` (`POST /api/budget/measure`). Computers with less than 12 GB RAM automatically use tier A (4,096-token context and shorter prompts).

English: A little pet lives in the bottom-right corner of your desktop, with a work window nearby. Lulu helps with everyday office tasks. The model runs on your own computer, or you can connect your own API or `claude -p`. Chats, notes, reminders, and generated files are stored locally.

English: python packaging/build_release.py --platform macos             # Assemble dist/Lulu-<version>-macos/ + ZIP + SHA256, including animations (--runtime points to a frozen LuluRuntime folder to remove the Python requirement)

中文: `.github/workflows/release.yml`：推 `v*` 标签或手动运行，CI 在 ubuntu 导出桌宠、在 windows/macos 冻结运行环境、组装安装包（动画包永远在里面；只有一种包），挂到草稿 Release。动画包放在名为 `assets-v1` 的 Release 里（`gh release create assets-v1 build/pet/frames.pck`）。
English: `.github/workflows/release.yml`: push a `v*` tag or run manually. CI exports the pet on Ubuntu, freezes runtimes on Windows/macOS, assembles the package (always including animations; only one package type), and attaches it to a draft Release. The animation pack is stored in the `assets-v1` Release (`gh release create assets-v1 build/pet/frames.pck`).

中文: Windows / macOS 真机安装验收（签名提示、SmartScreen）；LICENSE；A 档（3B/4B）模型接入与复测；记忆自动抽取（当前只保存用户明确要求记住的内容）；DOCX 转 PDF 仍为文本重建。
English: Real-device installation acceptance on Windows / macOS (signing prompts and SmartScreen); LICENSE; tier A (3B/4B) model integration and retesting; automatic memory extraction (currently only explicitly requested memories are saved); DOCX-to-PDF still rebuilds from text.

中文: 第一次双击 **{installer}** 时 macOS 会说“无法验证”，只给“完成”按钮——点“完成”，**再双击一次**就能打开（或到 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 点“仍要打开”）。只有第一次会这样，之后不再问。
English: The first time you double-click **{installer}**, macOS says it "cannot verify" it and only offers Done — click Done, then **double-click it again** and it opens (or go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway). This happens once; you are not asked again.

中文: 原因是程序没有付费的苹果签名。安装脚本跑起来后会自动去掉桌宠程序的隔离标记并做本机签名，所以后面不会再被拦；万一桌宠仍打不开，同样到 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 点“仍要打开”。
English: The reason is that the program has no paid Apple signing certificate. Once the installer is running it removes the quarantine flag from the pet program and signs it locally, so nothing else gets blocked; if the pet still refuses to open, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway as well.

中文: 你好，我是 Lulu，一只住在桌面上的小水豚。平时陪你待着，需要帮忙时，打开工作窗口就能翻译、整理文件、写点东西、记事或设提醒。
English: Hi, I'm Lulu, a little capybara on your desktop. I'll keep you company, and when you need a hand, open the work window to translate, work with files, write something, take notes, or set a reminder.
## Open Lulu for the first time

中文: 1. 完整解压 ZIP，把整个文件夹放到你想保存的位置。不要在压缩包里直接运行，也不要只移出其中的程序。
English: 1. Extract the entire ZIP and put the folder where you'd like to keep it. Don't run Lulu from inside the archive or move the app out on its own.

中文: 2. 双击 **`{installer}`**。首次运行会检查动画包，并提示你选择是否下载本地模型。
English: 2. Double-click **`{installer}`**. The first run checks the animation pack and asks whether you'd like to download a local model.

中文: 3. 桌宠出现后，点旁边的“聊聊天”打开工作窗口。
English: 3. When the pet appears, click “Chat” beside it to open the work window.

中文: 之后每次双击同一个脚本即可启动。包里已包含全部动画和运行环境，**不需要安装 Python**。
English: Use the same launcher next time. All animations and the runtime are included. **You don't need to install Python.**

中文: 默认使用电脑上的 Qwen3 模型。请先安装 [Ollama](https://ollama.com/download)，再运行启动脚本，按提示下载模型：
English: By default, Lulu uses Qwen3 on your computer. Install [Ollama](https://ollama.com/download) first, then run the launcher and follow the model download prompt:

中文: - 内存 **16GB 及以上**：8B 模型，约 5GB。
English: - **16 GB RAM or more:** the 8B model, about 5 GB.

中文: - 内存不足 16GB：两个 4B 模型，合计约 5GB。
English: - Less than 16 GB RAM: two 4B models, about 5 GB combined.

中文: 模型需要另外下载，不包含在这个安装包里。下载完成后的本地推理不需要联网；天气和联网搜索仍需要网络。
English: Models are downloaded separately, not included in this package. Once downloaded, the local model can answer offline. Weather and web search still need an internet connection.

中文: 如果已有 API 或命令行工具，可以不安装 Ollama、不下载本地模型，先打开 Lulu，在“设置 → 模型”选择 API、Claude 命令行或其他命令行，配置后点“检查连接”。外部服务是否收费取决于你使用的账号或服务。
English: Already have an API or command-line tool? You can open Lulu without Ollama or local models. Under Settings → Model, choose API, Claude command line, or another command-line tool, enter the details, and click “Check connection”. External service charges depend on your account and provider.

中文: 在输入框上方选一个标签，再输入内容或选择文件：
English: Choose a tab above the message box, then type or select a file:

中文: - **翻译 / 总结 / 改写润色**：贴上文字，选语言、长度或语气。
English: - **Translate / Summarize / Rewrite:** paste text and choose a language, length, or tone.

中文: - **问文件 / 提取成表**：选文件，再写问题或需要的表格列名。
English: - **Ask about a file / Make a table:** choose a file, then add your question or column names.

中文: - **按要点写 / 转格式**：提供要点和材料，或选择文件与目标格式。
English: - **Write from notes / Convert:** provide key points and sources, or choose a file and output format.

中文: - **记一下 / 提醒 / 查一下 / 聊聊天**：直接告诉 Lulu 要记什么、何时提醒，或想查、想聊什么。
English: - **Remember this / Remind me / Look it up / Chat:** tell Lulu what to remember, when to remind you, or what's on your mind.

中文: 例如：“30分钟后提醒我喝水”。请核对回复中的时间，并让 Lulu 保持运行；关闭期间错过的提醒会在下次打开时补送。
English: Try “Remind me to drink water in 30 minutes”. Check the time in the reply and keep Lulu running. If you close it, missed reminders are delivered next time you open it.

中文: 字太小可以在设置里调大界面。“深度思考”默认关闭，打开后本地模型可能多花一两分钟。
English: Text too small? Increase the interface size in Settings. “Deep thinking” is off by default; turning it on may add a minute or two with a local model.

中文: 对话、笔记、记忆、提醒和生成的文件保存在：
English: Chats, notes, memories, reminders, and generated files are stored here:

中文: 密钥另存于该目录下的 `data/secrets.json`。默认本地模型在本机处理；使用外部 API 或命令行服务时，请求和相关资料可能发往所选服务，界面会提示。天气、城市定位和联网搜索也会访问网络。
English: Keys are stored separately in `data/secrets.json` inside that folder. The default local model processes requests on your computer. External APIs or command-line services may receive your requests and relevant material; the interface shows a notice. Weather, city lookup, and web search also use the internet.

中文: 卸载时先退出 Lulu，再删除安装文件夹。数据目录会保留；更新或重装时不要删除它。
English: To uninstall, quit Lulu and delete the installation folder. Your data folder remains. Keep it when updating or reinstalling.

中文: 不支持扫描 PDF 的文字识别，也不能完整保留复杂文档排版。小模型可能出错，重要结果请核对。无密钥联网搜索可能慢或失败。8GB 内存旧电脑是设计目标，尚未完成该配置的真机验收。
English: Scanned-PDF text recognition and full preservation of complex document layouts aren't supported. Small models can make mistakes, so check important results. Key-free web search may be slow or fail. Older computers with 8 GB RAM are a design target that hasn't completed real-device acceptance testing. The English edition hasn't been tried by a native English speaker yet.

中文: 启动失败时可能打开 `启动问题.txt`，更详细的日志在：
English: A startup failure may open `Startup issues.txt`. The detailed log is here:

中文: 反馈时附上系统、包名、操作步骤和相关报错即可。分享日志前请检查其中是否有个人内容。
English: When reporting a problem, include your system, package name, what you did, and the relevant error. Check logs for personal information before sharing them.

中文: 版本：{version}（{build_date}）。ZIP 的校验值见下载页面上与包名对应的 `.sha256` 文件。
English: Version: {version} ({build_date}). The ZIP's checksum is in the matching `.sha256` file on the download page.

中文: 首次双击可能出现“无法验证”，只显示“完成”。点“完成”后再双击一次；若仍被拦，到“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开”。
English: On the first attempt, macOS may show “cannot verify” with only a Done button. Click Done, then double-click again. If it is still blocked, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

中文: 这版没有 Apple 开发者签名与公证。安装脚本会移除隔离标记并在本机签名。
English: This release is not developer-signed or notarized by Apple. The installer removes the quarantine flag and signs the app locally.

中文: SmartScreen 可能显示“Windows 已保护你的电脑”。确认下载自本项目后，点“更多信息 → 仍要运行”。这版没有代码签名证书。
English: SmartScreen may show “Windows protected your PC”. If you downloaded Lulu from this project, choose More info → Run anyway. This release has no code-signing certificate.

中文: Windows 包由 CI 构建并通过冒烟测试，尚未在真实 Windows 电脑上安装验收。遇到问题欢迎反馈。
English: The Windows package is built and smoke-tested in CI. It has not yet been installed and checked on a real Windows PC. Please let us know if you run into trouble.

中文: 第一次运行前给脚本加执行权限：chmod +x "{installer}"。
English: Before the first run, make the script executable: chmod +x "{installer}".
